limitations: All masses except nominal battery family rating are provisional estimates.
Caster is an ideal ball with a spherical bearing constraint.
Tire friction, rolling drag, motor torque and camera FOV are assumed and require later measurement.
Reflected gearmotor inertia is approximated by uniform wheel inertia scaling to 0.0005 kg m2 on the free axle; this is not a measured motor model.

Sensing blind band: thin objects confined to 98.5-147.5 mm (above the bumper skin top, bumper_top_z_m, and below the LiDAR scan plane) and object undersides at 147.5-155.15 mm (between the LiDAR plane and the robot top, robot_top_z_m) are invisible to the LiDAR and above the bumper, so nothing senses them; the upper structure (lid, LiDAR tray and turret; above the LiDAR plane only the turret) collides with them. The controller handles them only through stall marks (lidar_brain.mark_stall: the wheels turn, the LiDAR shows no motion, nothing is sensed), at most STALL_MARK_LIMIT per session.

Camera window (task F): the real bumper has a 44.5 mm wide window at z 65.9-93.1 mm round the camera lens, across the bumper seam (cad/parameters.json camera_window). The bumper probes here are uniform, so an object small enough to pass that window, which would reach the lens unsensed on the real robot, trips the simulated bumper instead.

Masses, centre of mass and body_inertia_kg_m2 come from the CAD (cad/mass-properties.json): printed parts at CAD volume x PETG 1.27 g/cm3 x a per-part fill, bought parts at their recorded masses at CAD solid centroids, each group a uniform solid of its CAD envelope for the inertia. Not weighed or measured.

Chassis inertia and upper collider in Unreal: RobotPawn sets the Body inertia from body_inertia_kg_m2 (principal moments and axes, after the COM nudge; log INERTIA_FIX, state physics_body_inertia_kg_m2), not from its collider. Above the body collider (up to the lid top, body_top_z_m) only the LiDAR column collides: a 32-gon prism circumscribing the turret cylinder (lidar_turret_xy_m, lidar_turret_radius_m) from the lid top to the robot top; the parts of the LiDAR tray and LD14 housing outside the turret footprint are not colliders.
frame: metres unless noted; robot frame x forward, y left, z up. base_link = round-shell centre = drive-axle midpoint, AT FLOOR LEVEL; every mount z (camera_mount_m, lidar_mount_m, cliff_z_m, shell_bottom_z_m, body_top_z_m, robot_top_z_m) is a height above the floor. base_link_height_m is the nominal body-origin height (RobotPawn BodyHeight) used by the controller convention base_link + offset, e.g. camera z 0.085 + -0.005 = 0.08 above the floor; camera_mount_from_body_origin_m and lidar_mount_from_body_origin_m give the mounts in that body-origin form (z minus base_link_height_m). rigid_radius_m is the fixed rear shell, bumper_shell_radius_m the moving bumper shell under the skin (body_radius_m); bumper_top_z_m is the skin top edge (no bumper sensing above it); body_top_z_m the lid top; robot_top_z_m the whole robot top (LiDAR turret cap); lidar_turret_* the turret cylinder (centre xy, radius, z range), the only part above the LiDAR plane. rear_caster_z_m is the ball bottom above the floor at rest (0 = touching). bump_zone_edges_deg is the full ascending list: zone i (bump_zones bit i, named bump_zone_names[i]) spans edges[i]..edges[i+1], azimuth about base_link, + = left; its outer values are -/+bumper_span_deg (the half-span). bump_left/right_switch_zone_mask: zones that trip each switch. Masses kg, positions mm: records = the chassis Body (sum = body_mass_kg); separate_body_records = the drive-wheel pair (wheel_mass_kg each) and the caster ball; body_inertia_kg_m2 is about estimated_body_com_mm.
